inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 Annual Report note 5 / cash-flow reconciliation: share-based payments expense US$1,299k (FY2024 US$4,077k incl. US$884k Quadrant sign-on). Rights are settled by issuing shares with no cash tax withholding disclosed, so equity_award_taxes = 0.
inputs.buyback_note: No buybacks in the USD era (FY2021-FY2025 all nil). The flat count is a modelling convention the company has not paid for; historically it has done the opposite (US$57.4m FY2023 and US$42.1m FY2024 equity raises).
inputs.share_count_basis: fully diluted: 268,523,648 shares on issue at 30-Jun-2026 (H1 FY2026 note 12) + 18,842,259 unvested performance rights (21,755,268 at 31-Dec-2025 per FY2025 note on share-based payments, less 2,913,009 exercised in H1 FY2026; the EPS note reports rights as antidilutive only because the company is loss-making). Held FLAT because forward SBC is fully expensed; the 2024 grant of 21.7m rights was struck at trough prices so the P&L expense understates its cost -- including the unvested rights in the divisor is the charge for those past grants.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-09-21T06:10:31Z ASX regular close (Yahoo regularMarketTime); 52wk A$0.65-1.975; 25 days after the 27-Aug-2026 H1 result (-14% on the day)
inputs.fx_rate_direction: AUD -> USD multiplier (Yahoo AUDUSD=X): takes the ASX price to the USD of the financials; used by scripts/sanity_check.py and refresh_price.py
inputs.fx_note: Statements and flows in USD (presentation currency changed from AUD on 1-Jan-2021, retrospectively restated); ASX quote in AUD. All per-share values computed in USD then converted at USD/AUD 1.4019 (AUDUSD=X 0.7133, Yahoo, 2026-09-21T11:10:08Z). Parity check on the OTC line: APPEF US$0.7123 (stale print, 2026-09-18) vs A$1.05 x 0.7133 = US$0.749 -- a 5% gap on a frozen OTC quote that traded when APX.AX was ~A$1.00, so direction and basis are confirmed. A 5% AUD rally cuts every AUD value here by ~5%.
inputs.model_currency_note: currency=USD is the ISO code of the statements; quote_currency=AUD is the ISO code of the ASX price. Unsuffixed intrinsic_value / weighted_iv / entry_price are AUD (quote currency); *_usd twins carry the model currency.
inputs.fy2026_guidance: Revenue US$270-300m; underlying EBITDA before FX margin 5-10% (reaffirmed 27-Aug-2026). Base case takes US$275m (H1 US$119.9m, so H2 must grow ~21% YoY just to reach the floor) at 6.0% statutory EBITDA (~7% underlying before FX, lower-middle of the guide: H1 was 4.5% underlying / 3.0% statutory but the business is H2-weighted -- H2 FY2025 ran ~11% underlying before FX).
inputs.unrecognised_tax_losses: US US$104m, China US$20m (FY2025 note): no deferred tax asset recognised. US NOLs shelter Appen Global if it ever earns; China profits are taxed at 25% with no offset from Global losses, which is why the modelled cash tax rate on group EBIT starts above 25%.
inputs.wacc_rationale: USD-built, because the flows are USD: US 10y 5.0% (Yahoo ^TNX 2026-09-21) + 5.0% ERP x beta 1.4 (small-cap, loss-making, 74% top-5 customer concentration, cyclical AI-capex exposure; market cap ~US$200m) = 12.0% cost of equity = WACC (no debt). Same rate in all three scenarios and NO ad-hoc concentration/cyclicality premium: those risks are charged in the scenario flows and in the 30% bear weight (owner-fcf.md s7f, charge risk once). Converting the USD result at spot AUDUSD is the currency bridge; the discount rate is not adjusted for the AUD quote.
notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF (dcf-methods SKILL routing: operating company, non-US + cyclical -> owner-fcf.md incl. section 7), 10-year explicit horizon because margins and capex intensity are still ramping, component-built margins, scenario-weighted. Fresh build -- no prior APX.AX DCF and no MEMORY.md entry. Not routed to the distressed/asset-waterfall model: the company has no debt, US$44.7m cash, positive and guided EBITDA, and a going-concern audit opinion; the distress is in the history, not the balance sheet.

OWNER FCF (FY2025, US$m): reported FCF 6.329 (OCF 22.966 - capex 16.637) - SBC 1.299 - interest income 0.773 - lease payments 4.848 = -0.591. Interest income is stripped because net cash (US$44.7m) is many times the FCF base and is added back in the bridge. TTM to Jun-2026 owner FCF is -20.5 (H1 FY2026 OCF -4.1 on a US$12.8m contract-asset build).

LEASES: treatment (B) -- leases as operating cost. The full FY2025 lease payment (principal 4.158 + interest 0.690, FY2025 note 14) is charged inside the flows at 1.7% of revenue (2.1% in FY2025 on a shrinking office footprint, liability 11.0 -> 9.4 -> 7.4); lease liabilities are EXCLUDED from net debt, so net debt = -cash = -44.705. D&A and capex are modelled ex right-of-use (ROU depreciation was 2.4 of the 31.3 D&A) and ex acquisition-related amortisation (13.0 non-cash, Figure Eight / Quadrant platforms).

CURRENCY BREAK: the Metrics CSV rows FY2014-FY2020 are AUD and H1 FY2021 onward are USD. No growth rate, margin or FCF series in this model crosses that boundary in mixed currencies; the 5-year CAGRs use the USD-restated FY2020 comparatives from the FY2021 annual report. The pre-2021 AUD peak (A$599m revenue, 18% EBITDA margin) belonged to the Google search-relevance business that no longer exists and is NOT used as a mid-cycle reference.

MID-CYCLE: FY2022 (-US$195.9m statutory EBITDA incl. US$204.3m impairment) and FY2023 (-US$88.6m incl. US$69.2m impairment) are excluded as reference years; so is the AUD-era peak. The margin path is anchored on the segment build instead: Appen China ran a 15.9% EBITDA margin in H1 FY2026 (US$12.1m on US$76.2m) while Appen Global lost US$4.5m on US$43.7m and corporate cost ~US$2m. Base assumes China reaches ~80% of revenue at a 15-16% margin with Global at breakeven, giving an 11% mature group margin (post-AASB16, before the 1.7% lease charge). Bull 15% (Global recovers to a 5% margin on foundation-model work); bear 5% (guidance floor, Global keeps shrinking).

DILUTION: the 123m -> 268m share count was US$57.4m (FY2023) and US$42.1m (FY2024) of equity raises, not SBC (SBC was US$1.3-5.7m/yr). The model does not project further raises: base and bull are cash-generative from year 4-5 and the bear case burns ~US$30m against US$44.7m cash, which is survivable without a raise. If the bear path materialises with a raise at ~A$0.60, existing holders would be diluted a further ~15%.

WORKING CAPITAL: sign is NEGATIVE (services business: receivables + contract assets US$68.4m vs contract liabilities US$13.0m at Jun-2026; net working capital ~12% of revenue). Modelled as -12% capture on the CHANGE in revenue in base (-10% bull, -15% bear); in the bear decline year it releases cash. The FY2025 US$12m receivables release that made owner FCF ~breakeven is treated as timing and is not carried forward.

TAX: cash tax = max(0, EBIT) x rate. Because US$104m of US losses are unrecognised and Global loses money, group EBIT is negative in base years 1-2 and the engine books zero tax -- but Appen China pays ~25% on its own profit regardless (H1 FY2026 cash tax US$1.7m). That leakage (~US$2-3m/yr, ~A$0.01/share PV) is understated by the engine in the negative-EBIT years; the 30% -> 25% path on positive EBIT is set above the 25% China statutory rate to partly compensate.

SANITY ANCHORS: market cap A$282m / US$201m on 268.5m shares on issue (US$215m on the diluted count); EV US$156-171m = 0.63-0.69x TTM revenue and ~8x the FY2026 guided EBITDA midpoint (US$21m). The base case values the equity at ~0.5x sales; the bull case at ~1.1x.
PRICE is a regular ASX close, not an after-hours print; the stock has ranged A$0.65-1.975 in 12 months and fell 14% on the H1 result day, so expect volatility.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: base-case 10-year revenue CAGR (judgment: FY2025 US$230.8m -> FY2035 US$540.5m). Every historical CAGR describes the collapse of the Google/search-relevance business (revenue -11%/yr over 5y in USD, equity -24%/yr) and none is a forward proxy; the forward path is built segment-by-segment (China +80% decelerating, Global -30% stabilising).
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5y CAGR -24.0% diverges >30% from revenue 5y CAGR -11.0%: US$273m of goodwill/intangible impairments in FY2022-23 destroyed book value faster than revenue fell. EPS and owner-FCF CAGRs are undefined (negative endpoints).
historical_growth.currency_break_note: Statements were presented in AUD to FY2020 and in USD from FY2021 (retrospective restatement, 1-Jan-2021). All CAGRs here use the USD series only; FY2020 comparatives are the USD-restated figures from the FY2021 annual report (revenue US$412.7m, equity US$373.7m), not the AUD rows in the Metrics CSV. No series in this file spans the 2020->2021 boundary in mixed currencies.
historical_growth.notes: Owner FCF = reported FCF - SBC - interest income - lease payments (principal + interest), applied to the whole USD-era history. Owner FCF has been negative every year since the currency switch (FY2022 -15.9, FY2023 -53.6, FY2024 -22.5, FY2025 -0.6, TTM -20.5); the FY2025 near-breakeven was helped by a US$12m working-capital release that reversed in H1 FY2026 (contract assets +US$12.8m on China growth). SBC is small (0.56% of revenue) -- the 123m -> 268m share count growth came from US$57.4m (FY2023) and US$42.1m (FY2024) equity raises, not from SBC.

scenario_narratives.base: FY2026 revenue US$275m (+19%, low end of the US$270-300m guide: H1 was US$119.9m, H2 needs +21% YoY) at a 6.0% statutory EBITDA margin (~7% underlying before FX; H1 was 4.5%/3.0% but H2 FY2025 ran ~11%, so the year is H2-weighted). Appen China (+80% H1) decelerates to +30%/+20%/+12% and reaches ~80% of group revenue by FY2029 while Appen Global (-27% H1) shrinks a further ~30% then stabilises on foundation-model/RLHF work outside its largest client, giving group growth of 16/13/10/8% in FY2027-30 and a 3.5% exit. Group EBITDA margin climbs ~1pp/yr to 11% by FY2032 as China's 16% segment margin dominates the mix and Global reaches breakeven. Capex (capitalised product development) falls from 6.5% to 3.5% of revenue now that CrowdGen/Mercury replatforming is done; working capital consumes 12% of every revenue dollar added. Owner FCF is negative through FY2028 (-13/-8/-3) and only reaches a 2.7% margin at maturity: the cash the business generates at an 11% EBITDA margin is thin once leases, capex, China tax and receivables growth are paid for.
scenario_narratives.bull: The Meta-Scale AI neutrality shock converts into durable share gains at Google, Microsoft, OpenAI and xAI, Appen Global returns to growth on RLHF/agentic-environment work, and Appen China sustains 40%+ growth on Chinese labs' international expansion: revenue US$286m (+24%) in FY2026 compounding at 22/18/14/11% to ~US$860m by FY2035. Operating leverage on a 40%+ gross margin takes group EBITDA to 15% by FY2033 (China 18%, Global 5%, corporate 1%). Working-capital drag eases to 10% as hyperscaler terms improve. Terminal growth 3.5%. This is the analyst-target (A$2.35) world and needs four things to go right at once: Scale share shift, Global stabilisation, China deceleration only gradual, and no large-client loss.
scenario_narratives.bear: FY2026 lands just under the guidance floor (US$258m, +12%) at a 3.5% margin, then a top-5 client cuts volumes in FY2027 -- the Google FY2024 pattern repeated with a Chinese lab or hyperscaler -- and revenue falls 12% and 2% before creeping back at 2-3%. Margins collapse to 1% in the loss year and recover only to 5% because the crowd-based model has no pricing power against in-house RLHF pipelines and offshore niche vendors. At a 5% EBITDA margin the business never generates owner FCF (year-10 FCF -US$5m), so the terminal value sits on the ZERO FLOOR and the equity is worth the cash pile less a decade of burn: A$0.03/share. The bear case is a slow liquidation, not a bankruptcy -- no debt, and US$44.7m cash covers the ~US$30m cumulative burn without a raise.

entry_price.method: Price at which buying today, collecting the projected owner FCF and exiting in year 10 earns a 15% IRR: (sum FCF_t/1.15^t + max(0, min(FCF_10 x (1+g)/(0.15-g), 15 x FCF_10))/1.15^10 + net cash) / diluted shares. Terminal value is BUILT at the hurdle rate (owner-fcf.md s4, 2026-09-01 rule). Computed per scenario in USD, converted to AUD, then probability-weighted.
entry_price.note: At A$1.05 the base case returns ~7.2% IRR with TV rebuilt at that rate. The bear-case entry price (A$-0.02) is essentially the cash; the 15% hurdle is met only if the bear case is avoided.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (min(Gordon@r, 15x FCF_10), floored at 0). The 15% row equals the base entry price; the 12% row equals valuation.base.intrinsic_value.

sensitivity.note: Rows = WACC 10-14%, columns = terminal growth 2.0-4.0% (base 3.0% +/-1pp). Terminal value re-capped at 15x FCF_10 in every cell. House pair is [12%, 3.0%].

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear 30% / base 50% / bull 20%, against the 15/50/35 house default. Bear is doubled because the thesis rests on an unproven pivot with a single-customer-dependency history (Google walked in FY2024 and took ~US$60m of revenue with it; top-5 clients are still 68-74% of revenue), Appen Global is still shrinking 27%, and TTM owner FCF is -US$20m. Bull is cut because it needs the Scale-AI share shift, Global stabilisation, only gradual China deceleration and no client loss to all hold at once.
probability_weighted.band_note: SBC is only 0.6-0.7% of revenue so the house/street band is narrow (A$0.61 to A$0.73); the price at A$1.05 sits 364% of the way across it, i.e. far ABOVE the street ceiling -- the market is not paying for SBC treatment, it is paying for the bull case.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Owner-FCF DCF on strict owner economics -- SBC expensed, interest income stripped, the full IFRS-16 lease payment charged in the flows, capex and China tax paid, and working capital tied to growth (negative capture, because a services business funds receivables and contract assets as it grows). Every historical series is USD-only; the AUD era (FY2014-FY2020) and the FY2022-23 impairment years are excluded as references and the margin path is built from the two segments instead. On that basis Appen at A$1.05 (EV ~US$160m, 0.65x TTM sales, ~8x guided FY2026 EBITDA) is priced between the base case (A$0.63) and the bull case (A$1.51): the market is underwriting Appen China compounding at 40%+ with Global recovering, and a 15% group margin. The house view is that an 11% mature margin on a US$530m revenue base yields only ~US$14m of owner FCF a decade out -- a 2.7% FCF margin -- so the probability-weighted value is A$0.61 and the 15%-hurdle entry price A$0.43. The stock is a turnaround call option on Appen China, not a compounder; the bear case is a slow cash-funded shrink to A$-0.04, which is why it carries 30% weight.
valuation_philosophy.sbc_treatment: expensed in flows; share count flat at 287.4m fully diluted (268.5m on issue + 18.8m unvested rights)
valuation_philosophy.lease_treatment: B -- full lease payment (principal + interest) in flows; lease liabilities excluded from net debt
valuation_philosophy.currency_treatment: USD model, AUD outputs at spot AUDUSD 0.7133; WACC built from USD rates
valuation_philosophy.mid_cycle_treatment: segment-built margin path (China 15-16% / Global breakeven -> 11% group) instead of any historical average; FY2022-23 impairment years and the AUD-era Google peak excluded

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
